notes:
New
- A new sidebar replaces the rail: tabs for Library, Projects and Outputs, More, All projects, and a status ring on every project; in an editor the sidebar opens over the page
- Visitors’ hearts and comments on your galleries: share switches for each, counts on the gallery’s page and its tiles, a Comments panel, Visitors, unread marks in Outputs, Hearts and Has comments filters in the grid, and a Comments tab in the Info panel
- A sync issue’s details list each item with Retry and Forget, and Journal media this Mac can’t get shows as a sync issue
- Update required: when Meki Cloud needs a newer Meki, a dialog, a banner and the Cloud button say so, and cloud work waits until you update
- The Welcome screen’s contact sheet shows real photographs

Improved
- Controls, menus, dialogs, progress bars, filter bar, cull bar and photo tiles follow the updated design throughout
- Previews are sized for this Mac’s largest display and no longer change with the window
- The preview cache keeps to its limit: it frees previews nothing needs first, grids always stay, and previews waiting for Meki Cloud have their own room
- A task can move to another project, and capture-time shifts, smart albums and tag edits made on the web arrive the same on the Mac
- Long tab rows scroll and keep the chosen tab in view

Fixed
- Restoring a library from Meki Cloud or joining one from another Mac finishes its setup after an interruption and keeps this Mac’s identity
- Downloads of originals: the loupe and Compare show the right state, a download that can’t finish says why once, and a copy missing from a connected drive is reported instead of waited for
- The loupe starts on WebGL2 when WebGPU never answers, and detail tiles no longer appear before the photo is in place
- Lightroom: a refocus or relaunch never reopens a closed Lightroom, the connection test puts Lightroom’s view back, and Pair stays offered when pairing is needed
- Lightroom Classic quits cleanly while Meki is catching up
- Finding people no longer loops on photos whose preview is missing, and resumes when a catalog drive returns
- Bring your library waits for a pulled source or archive drive and resumes when it returns
- Sync no longer misses a change made during a pass, and a flapping connection no longer starts a pass on every reconnect
- Pausing a task always wins over Meki resuming it, and a cancelled part no longer counts in a task’s total
- Export previews and soft proofs asked for twice at once all answer
- Changing a photo’s capture time moves every file of the photo together, and a change made on the web re-matches its photos to GPS tracks
- At 100% with noise reduction, pixels at colour edges match the full render
- Dialogs focus the right control, and Escape in a menu or toast no longer closes the dialog under it
- Smaller fixes across the sidebar, Settings, galleries and moving folders
